svg.aria-label: The core's 4-bit adder drawn as logic, lit clock by clock from the RTL simulation: add x11, x9, x10 takes eight clocks, one nibble each, the carry held in a flip-flop between them; then a subtract inverts B and starts the carry at 1

every register in the file turns one nibble each clock; nibble k of all of them sits on the read ports at phase k

Phase 7: nibble 7 of x9 is 1 and of x10 is 0. The carry flip-flop brings in 1. In hex, 1 + 0 + 1 = 02: nibble 2 goes into x11, 0 into the carry flip-

sub x7, x3, x4 · phase 0 · cycle 940
Phase 0: nibble 0 of x3 is f and of x4 is 0, inverted to f because this is a subtract. The carry starts at 1, the sub bit itself: a − b is done as a +
~b + 1. In hex, f + f + 1 = 1f: nibble f goes into x7, 1 into the carry flip-flop.
sub x7, x3, x4 · phase 1 · cycle 941
Phase 1: nibble 1 of x3 is 0 and of x4 is 1, inverted to e because this is a subtract. The carry flip-flop brings in 1. In hex, 0 + e + 1 = 0f: nibble
f goes into x7, 0 into the carry flip-flop: in a subtract, a carry of 0 is a borrow.

f goes into x7, 0 into the carry flip-flop: in a subtract, a carry of 0 is a borrow.
